statement: At the production-defined settled cold-seed checkpoint before the first join, the simulator hosts 45 critical partition groups, 3 replica identities per group and 135 actual Raft-capable replica runtimes, every one of them executing on node-0 and charging the single node-0 busyUntil - and every identity, grouping, placement, peer set and election start comes from the same production owners that create them outside the simulator, never from harness constants. A joining node becomes a member without automatically receiving a replica; a replica appears on a joiner only after the production placement or operation owner authorises one.

constraints.statement: The runtime factory may adapt durable storage to an in-memory implementation, the transport endpoint to VirtualNetwork, the clock to networkTimeSource(nodeId) and the random source to a seeded RandomSource. It may not choose ids, counts, placement, peers or election eligibility: those are already production decisions. formation-sim-raft-cohort.js stops participating in the positive scenario and the one-group-per-PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_TABLE_IDS mapping is retired, because table ids are not partition ids.

All 135 cold replicas execute on one simulated process. Every timer, protocol callback, transport callback, apply continuation and bootstrap continuation belonging to them carries executionNodeId node-0 and charges the single node-0 busyUntil. There is no CPU lane per replica; 135 concurrent state machines share one event loop.

Raft traffic between co-located replicas still travels through the production transport abstraction the replica lifecycle uses. The adapter may translate a production address to an in-process VirtualNetwork destination, but the production transport calls still occur, because same-process request and reply work is still seed event-loop load.

Seed starts, production creates the 45 partitions and 135 replica runtimes, the cold population settles to the production-defined bootstrap boundary, and only then do nodes 1 to 4 join. No joiner replica runtime is pre-created.

Looping 45 x 3 and calling new PartitionService inside the harness is forbidden even though it would produce the right number: the repair is production declaration to production replica-construction authority to runtime, not creating 135 objects somehow. If faithfully invoking the production chain needs changes across too many owners, stop and decompose.

The strict substrate stays zero-seam and proof-eligible and repeated runs stay byte-identical. Live Raft rate parity is NOT required by this frontier: after composition correspondence the owner-rate table is remeasured without tuning, and only the opportunity-normalised residual is evidence about missing protocol triggers.
